notes: Faster save reads: the burner sends each part of your save over USB while it reads the next part, so games start sooner.
Game Boy and Game Boy Color reads use the same faster method.
The burner now answers commands it doesn't know, instead of leaving the app waiting.
Updates over USB from the website (Tools → Firmware update); no ST-Link needed after the first install.
The burner reports its name and firmware version to the website and the Android app.
